ruedas.what_es: Seis ruedas de aluminio con garras para agarrarse. Cada una tiene su propio motor y las cuatro de las esquinas también giran. Llevan al rover sobre rocas y arena.
ruedas.what_en: Six aluminum wheels with cleats for grip. Each has its own drive motor, and the four corner wheels also steer. They carry the rover across rock and sand.

facts.value_es: Aluminio, 0,5 m (20 pulgadas) de diámetro: el doble que las de Spirit y Opportunity
facts.value_en: Aluminum, 0.5 m (20 inches) across, twice the size of Spirit and Opportunity wheels

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: wheels are aluminum, 20 inches (0.5 meter) in diameter, which is twice the size of the wheels on Spirit and Opportunity

facts.value_es: Las seis ruedas tienen motor de tracción; las cuatro de las esquinas, también de dirección
facts.value_en: All six wheels have drive motors; the four corner wheels also have steering motors

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: Six wheels all have driver motors. The four corner wheels all have steering motors.

facts.value_es: Garras para tracción y rayos de titanio curvos que dan soporte elástico
facts.value_en: Cleats for traction and curved titanium spokes for springy support

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: They have cleats for traction and for structural support. Curving titanium spokes give springy support.

heritage.note_es: Perseverance rediseñó las ruedas para hacerlas más resistentes, por el desgaste que sufrieron las de Curiosity en rocas filosas.
heritage.note_en: Perseverance redesigned its wheels to be tougher, because of the wear Curiosity's wheels took on sharp rocks.

source.title: NASA Science, Perseverance Rover Components

heritage.quote: Engineers redesigned the Mars 2020 Perseverance rover's wheels to be more robust, due to wear and tear the Curiosity rover wheels endured

suspension.what_es: Un sistema de brazos articulados que une las ruedas al cuerpo. Mantiene las seis ruedas en contacto con el suelo aunque el terreno sea desigual, y permite pasar sobre rocas.
suspension.what_en: A system of pivoting arms that links the wheels to the body. It keeps all six wheels on the ground over uneven terrain, so the rover can roll over rocks.

facts.value_es: Mantiene las seis ruedas en contacto con el suelo, incluso al pasar sobre una roca grande como la rueda
facts.value_en: Keeps all six wheels in contact with the ground, even over a rock as big as a wheel

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: the rocker-bogie design enables a six-wheel vehicle to keep all its wheels in contact with the ground even on uneven terrain

facts.value_es: Unos 4 cm por segundo en suelo plano y duro
facts.value_en: About 4 cm per second on flat, hard ground

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: The rover has a top speed on flat, hard ground of about 1.5 inches (4 centimeters) per second.

facts.value_es: Más de 20 km durante la misión principal
facts.value_en: More than 20 km during the prime mission

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: capable of driving more than 12 miles (more than 20 kilometers) during the prime mission

heritage.note_es: Spirit y su gemelo Opportunity ya usaban suspensión rocker-bogie, con un motor por rueda.
heritage.note_en: Spirit and its twin Opportunity already used a rocker-bogie suspension, with a motor on each wheel.

source.title: NASA NSSDCA, Spirit (2003-027A)

heritage.quote: The wheels are attached to a rocker-bogie suspension system. Each wheel has its own motor

heritage.note_es: Perseverance también rueda sobre seis ruedas con suspensión rocker-bogie.
heritage.note_en: Perseverance also rolls on six wheels with a rocker-bogie suspension.

source.title: NASA NSSDCA, Mars 2020 (2020-052A)

heritage.quote: Mobility is provided by the six wheels in a rocker-bogie suspension

cuerpo.what_es: La caja caliente del rover. Protege los dos computadores redundantes y los laboratorios internos SAM y CheMin, que analizan las muestras de roca y suelo.
cuerpo.what_en: The rover's warm electronics box. It protects the two redundant computers and the internal SAM and CheMin labs that analyze rock and soil samples.

facts.value_es: Unos 3 m de largo, 2,7 m de ancho y 2,1 m de alto (10 x 9 x 7 pies), sin contar el brazo
facts.value_en: About 3 m long, 2.7 m wide and 2.1 m tall (10 x 9 x 7 feet), not counting the arm

source.title: NASA Science, Mars Science Laboratory: Curiosity Rover

facts.quote: 10 feet long, 9 feet wide and 7 feet tall

facts.value_es: Procesador RAD750 de hasta 200 MHz en cada computador
facts.value_en: RAD750 processor of up to 200 MHz in each computer

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: This processor operates at up to 200 megahertz speed

facts.value_es: Detecta menos de una parte por mil millones de un compuesto orgánico
facts.value_en: Detects less than one part per billion of an organic compound

source.title: NASA Science, Curiosity Science Instruments

facts.quote: Detects less than one part-per-billion of an organic compound

heritage.note_es: Los rovers anteriores también guardaban su electrónica en una caja caliente (WEB) dentro del chasis.
heritage.note_en: Earlier rovers also kept their electronics in a warm electronics box (WEB) inside the chassis.

source.title: NASA NSSDCA, Spirit (2003-027A)

heritage.quote: The chassis contains the warm electronics box (WEB).

heritage.note_es: Perseverance se basa en la configuración de Curiosity y también usa un cuerpo WEB.
heritage.note_en: Perseverance is based on Curiosity's configuration and also uses a WEB body.

source.title: NASA Science, Perseverance Rover Components

heritage.quote: The Mars 2020 rover, Perseverance, is based on the Mars Science Laboratory's Curiosity rover configuration

mastil.what_es: La cabeza del rover, a la altura de los ojos de una persona. Lleva Mastcam (fotos y video a color), ChemCam (un láser que vaporiza roca para analizarla) y las cámaras de navegación Navcam.
mastil.what_en: The rover's head, at human eye height. It carries Mastcam (color photos and video), ChemCam (a laser that vaporizes rock to analyze it) and the Navcam navigation cameras.

facts.value_es: Dos cámaras a color de 2 megapíxeles
facts.value_en: Two color cameras, 2 megapixels

source.title: NASA Science, Curiosity Science Instruments

facts.quote: Similar to that of consumer digital cameras; 2 megapixels.

facts.value_es: Usa un láser para vaporizar material y analiza su composición con un espectrógrafo
facts.value_en: Uses a laser to vaporize material, then analyzes its composition with a spectrograph

source.title: NASA Science, Curiosity Science Instruments

facts.quote: An instrument that first uses a laser to vaporize materials then later analyzes their elemental composition using an on-board spectrograph.

facts.value_es: Dos pares estéreo de cámaras de navegación
facts.value_en: Two stereo pairs of navigation cameras

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: Curiosity carries two stereo pairs of Navcams, one pair each connected to the rover

heritage.note_es: Mastcam-Z de Perseverance se basa directamente en Mastcam y añade zoom 4:1.
heritage.note_en: Perseverance's Mastcam-Z is based directly on Mastcam and adds a 4:1 zoom.

source.title: Bell et al., Space Science Reviews (2021), Mastcam-Z

heritage.quote: Mastcam-Z is a high-heritage imaging system based directly on the successful MSL Mastcam investigation

heritage.note_es: SuperCam de Perseverance es muy parecida a su antecesora ChemCam, con un telescopio distinto.
heritage.note_en: Perseverance's SuperCam looks very similar to its predecessor ChemCam, with a different telescope.

source.title: Maurice et al., Space Science Reviews (2021), SuperCam

heritage.quote: SuperCam looks very similar to its predecessor

heritage.note_es: Las Navcams son casi idénticas a las cámaras de ingeniería de Spirit y Opportunity.
heritage.note_en: The Navcams are virtually identical to the engineering cameras on Spirit and Opportunity.

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

heritage.quote: The cameras themselves are virtually identical to the engineering cameras on Spirit and Opportunity

brazo.what_es: Un brazo con cinco articulaciones que lleva la torreta de herramientas hasta las rocas y el suelo elegidos por los científicos, y maneja los mecanismos de procesamiento de muestras.
brazo.what_en: A five-joint arm that moves the tool turret to the rocks and soil chosen by scientists and operates the sample-processing mechanisms.

facts.value_es: Unos 2,2 m (7 pies)
facts.value_en: About 2.2 m (7 feet)

source.title: NASA Science, Mars Science Laboratory: Curiosity Rover

facts.quote: Arm reach About 7 feet (2.2 meters)

facts.value_es: Cinco grados de libertad: hombro (2), codo, muñeca y torreta
facts.value_en: Five degrees of freedom: shoulder (2), elbow, wrist and turret

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: The arm has five degrees of freedom of movement provided by rotary actuators

facts.value_es: Puede sostener la torreta de 33 kg con el brazo extendido
facts.value_en: Can hold the 33 kg turret with the arm fully extended

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: It is strong enough to hold the 73-pound (33-kilogram) turret at full extension of the arm.

heritage.note_es: El brazo de Perseverance parte del diseño de Curiosity, con ajustes en los motores y su electrónica para tomar núcleos de roca.
heritage.note_en: Perseverance's arm builds on the Curiosity design, modified in motor controller electronics for coring samples.

source.title: NASA Science, Perseverance Rover Components

heritage.quote: so the Curiosity design was modified to handle the new Perseverance rover motor controller electronics

torreta.what_es: La mano del brazo. Reúne el taladro, el espectrómetro APXS, la cámara MAHLI, el sistema CHIMRA que procesa muestras y un cepillo (DRT) que limpia el polvo de la roca.
torreta.what_en: The arm's hand. It holds the drill, the APXS spectrometer, the MAHLI camera, the CHIMRA sample processor and a brush (DRT) that sweeps dust off rock.

facts.value_es: Dos instrumentos científicos y tres dispositivos más
facts.value_en: Two science instruments and three other devices

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: holds two science instruments and three other devices

facts.value_es: Toma muestras hasta 5 cm bajo la superficie de la roca
facts.value_en: Collects samples up to 5 cm beneath the rock surface

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: It can collect a sample from up to 2 inches (5 centimeters) beneath a rock

facts.value_es: Diámetro de 1,6 cm
facts.value_en: Diameter 1.6 cm

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: The diameter of the drilled hole is 0.63 inch (1.6 centimeters).

heritage.note_es: Perseverance usa una torreta más grande, con taladro de núcleos, dos instrumentos y una cámara a color.
heritage.note_en: Perseverance uses a larger turret with a coring drill, two instruments and a color camera.

source.title: NASA Science, Perseverance Rover Components

heritage.quote: the rover has a larger "hand," or turret at the end of the robot arm

rtg.what_es: Una batería nuclear. Convierte el calor del plutonio-238 en electricidad, sin partes móviles, y también calienta los sistemas del rover en las noches frías de Marte.
rtg.what_en: A nuclear battery. It turns the heat of plutonium-238 into electricity and also warms the rover's systems during cold Martian nights.

facts.value_es: 4,8 kg de dióxido de plutonio
facts.value_en: 4.8 kg of plutonium dioxide

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: It contains 10.6 pounds (4.8 kilograms) of plutonium dioxide

facts.value_es: Poco más de 110 vatios
facts.value_en: Slightly more than 110 watts

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: as it generates electrical power in smaller increments, slightly more than 110 watts

facts.value_es: 64 cm de diámetro, 66 cm de largo y unos 45 kg
facts.value_en: 64 cm across, 66 cm long, about 45 kg

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: It is about 25 inches (64 centimeters) in diameter by 26 inches (66 centimeters) long and weighs about 99 pounds (45 kilograms).

heritage.note_es: El sistema de energía de Perseverance es idéntico al de Curiosity.
heritage.note_en: Perseverance's power system is identical to Curiosity's.

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars 2020 press kit, Power

heritage.quote: Perseverance's power system is identical to the one that the Curiosity rover has been using successfully since its launch in 2011.

heritage.note_es: Dragonfly, la misión a Titán, usará un MMRTG, un tipo de fuente similar al de Curiosity y Perseverance.
heritage.note_en: Dragonfly, the Titan mission, will use an MMRTG, a similar type of power source to Curiosity's and Perseverance's.

source.title: NASA Science, Dragonfly Spacecraft and Instruments

heritage.quote: Dragonfly will use an MMRTG (Multi-Mission Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator)

antenas.what_es: Tres antenas para comunicarse. Dos hablan directo con la Tierra (alta y baja ganancia, banda X) y una, la UHF, envía datos a satélites que orbitan Marte.
antenas.what_en: Three antennas for communication. Two talk directly to Earth (high and low gain, X band) and the UHF one sends data to orbiters around Mars.

facts.value_es: Tres antenas de telecomunicación
facts.value_en: Three telecommunication antennas

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: Curiosity has three antennas for telecommunication.

facts.value_es: Hexagonal, casi 0,3 m (1 pie) de diámetro; hay que apuntarla
facts.value_en: Hexagonal, nearly 0.3 m (1 foot) across; it must be pointed

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: which is hexagonally shaped, nearly 1 foot (0.3 meter) in diameter

facts.value_es: Banda de unos 400 MHz para enviar datos a orbitadores
facts.value_en: About 400 MHz band for relaying data via orbiters

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: using the ultra-high frequency (UHF) band (about 400 megahertz)

heritage.note_es: Spirit y Opportunity también llevaban antenas de alta ganancia, baja ganancia y UHF.
heritage.note_en: Spirit and Opportunity also carried high-gain, low-gain and UHF antennas.

source.title: NASA NSSDCA, Spirit (2003-027A)

heritage.quote: high gain, low gain, and UHF antennas

hazcams.what_es: Cámaras con lente ojo de pez, abajo en el frente y atrás del rover. Detectan rocas y zanjas, ayudan a conducir solo y a ubicar el brazo.
hazcams.what_en: Fisheye cameras low on the front and rear of the rover. They spot rocks and trenches, help it drive on its own and help place the arm.

facts.value_es: 124 grados de ancho y de alto (lente ojo de pez)
facts.value_en: 124 degrees wide and tall (fisheye lens)

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: Each Hazcam has a fisheye lens providing a square field of view 124 degrees wide and tall.

facts.value_es: Blanco y negro, en luz roja de unos 650 nm
facts.value_en: Grayscale, in red light near 650 nm

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: generate grayscale images that cover red wavelengths centered at about 650 nanometers

facts.value_es: 12 en total, de unos 250 g cada una
facts.value_en: 12 in total, about 250 g each

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

facts.quote: Curiosity has a total of 12 engineering cameras, each weighing about 9 ounces (250 grams).

heritage.note_es: Las Hazcams son prácticamente idénticas a las cámaras de ingeniería de Spirit y Opportunity, con redundancia y calentadores más potentes.
heritage.note_en: Hazcams are virtually identical to the engineering cameras of Spirit and Opportunity, with redundancy and stronger heaters added.

source.title: NASA/JPL, Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit (July 2012)

heritage.quote: The cameras themselves are virtually identical to the engineering cameras on Spirit and Opportunity

heritage.note_es: Perseverance cambió el diseño: lleva seis Hazcams nuevas, cuatro adelante y dos atrás.
heritage.note_en: Perseverance changed the design: six newly developed Hazcams, four in front and two at the rear.

source.title: NASA Science, Perseverance Rover Components

heritage.quote: Perseverance carries six newly developed Hazard Detection Cameras (HazCams): four in front and two on the rear.

missions.name: Mars Science Laboratory (Curiosity)
missions.where_es: Cráter Gale, Marte; hoy asciende por el monte Sharp
missions.where_en: Gale Crater, Mars; now climbing Mount Sharp
missions.summary_es: Rover de NASA lanzado el 26 de noviembre de 2011. Aterrizó en el cráter Gale en 2012, halló un antiguo entorno habitable y sube el monte Sharp. NASA lo lista como misión activa.
missions.summary_en: NASA rover launched on 26 November 2011. It landed in Gale Crater in 2012, found an ancient habitable environment and climbs Mount Sharp. NASA lists the mission as active.

milestones.text_es: Lanzamiento en un cohete Atlas V 541.
milestones.text_en: Launch on an Atlas V 541 rocket.

source.title: NASA NSSDCA, Mars Science Laboratory (2011-070A)

milestones.text_es: Aterrizaje en el cráter Gale: la etapa de descenso bajó el rover con cables (sky crane).
milestones.text_en: Landing in Gale Crater: the descent stage lowered the rover on a tether (sky crane).

source.title: NASA NSSDCA, Mars Science Laboratory (2011-070A)

milestones.quote: the rover being lowered to the surface from the descent stage on a tether. Touchdown occured at 05:32 UTC (1:32 EDT) on 6 August.

milestones.text_es: Primera muestra perforada en roca marciana (roca John Klein, sol 182).
milestones.text_en: First rock sample drilled on Mars (John Klein rock, sol 182).

source.title: NASA/JPL, Curiosity collects first Martian bedrock sample

milestones.quote: The drilling took place on Feb. 8, 2013, or Sol 182, Curiosity's 182nd Martian day of operations.

milestones.text_es: NASA anuncia que el análisis de la roca muestra un antiguo entorno que pudo sostener microbios.
milestones.text_en: NASA announces rock analysis shows an ancient environment that could have supported microbes.

source.title: NASA/JPL, Rover finds conditions once suited for ancient life on Mars

milestones.quote: An analysis of a rock sample collected by NASA's Curiosity rover shows ancient Mars could have supported living microbes.

milestones.text_es: Curiosity llega al monte Sharp, su destino principal de largo plazo.
milestones.text_en: Curiosity reaches Mount Sharp, its long-term prime destination.

source.title: NASA, Mars Curiosity Rover Arrives at Martian Mountain (release 14-245)

milestones.quote: NASA's Mars Curiosity rover has reached the Red Planet's Mount Sharp

milestones.text_es: Estado actual en la página de NASA (consultada hoy): misión activa; sigue explorando el registro de rocas de Marte.
milestones.text_en: Current status on NASA's page (checked today): active mission; it continues exploring Mars's rock record.

source.title: NASA Science, Mars Science Laboratory: Curiosity Rover

milestones.quote: It continues to explore the rock record from a time when Mars could have been home to microbial life.

source.title: NASA Science, Mars Science Laboratory: Curiosity Rover

notes: Odometer omitted on purpose: NASA mission page states elevation gain, not driven distance. Elevation: page says Curiosity 'reached the pinnacle - so far - of its 14-year-old mission on Aug. 26, 2026, when it marked an elevation gain of 1 kilometer' up Mount Sharp; page is labeled 'Active Mission' (read 2026-11-22). The three jpl.nasa.gov pages (first drill, habitability announcement, Mars 2020 power) return 403 to curl, so they were read with the WebFetch tool; their quotes could not be string-checked against local text and should be eyeballed once. Dragonfly year 2028 comes from NASA's Dragonfly fact sheet ('launch scheduled no earlier than 2028', https://science.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/dragonfly-factsheet-09102026a.pdf), not from the quoted page. Years for Mars Exploration Rovers (2003) and Mars 2020 (2020) are launch years from NSSDCA pages (Spirit 10 June 2003, Opportunity 8 July 2003, Mars 2020 30 July 2020); the press-kit quotes used for Navcam/Hazcam heritage do not themselves give the year. Sojourner/Mars Pathfinder rocker-bogie: press kit says Curiosity's mobility is 'a scaled-up version of what was used on the three earlier Mars rovers: Sojourner, Spirit and Opportunity' but no opened page tied Sojourner to rocker-bogie with a year, so only MER and Perseverance are listed. Antenna heritage is only 'same antenna types on MER'; no source states design inheritance. Mastcam-Z and SuperCam heritage come from peer-reviewed Space Science Reviews papers. Quotes with curly apostrophes in the source were normalized to straight ones in 'Mount Sharp' and Curiosity's lines. MMRTG first use on Curiosity: NASA RPS FAQ says 'MMRTG, which saw its first use on the Curiosity Mars rover' (https://science.nasa.gov/planetary-science/programs/radioisotope-power-systems/faq/). Body size in metres is converted from NASA's feet figures. NASA's Perseverance wheels article gives Curiosity wheels as 20 inches (50.8 cm).
